description: This file defines the class Smarty_Internal_Method_RegisterCacheResource, which provides a method to register a cache resource with a Smarty template engine object. The class includes properties and methods related to managing cache resource registration in the Smarty templating system.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_RegisterCacheResource
classes.description: A class responsible for registering cache resources in the Smarty templating engine.

methods.name: registerCacheResource
methods.description: Registers a cache resource handler for a given resource type in the Smarty environment.
